description: The ticket board accepts assigned_to_name as a list sort key and sorts by the primary assignee display name.

description: The ticket list accepts assigned_team_name and updated_at as sort keys in ascending and descending order.

description: Supported ticket-list sort keys survive URL updates, browser history, reload, and server-rendered first load.

description: Previous and next ticket navigation uses the same primary and tie-break ordering as the visible ticket list.
A user-safe action error returned by a ticket-list fetch is shown even when the caller supplies a generic fallback message.

description: An unexpected thrown ticket-list error continues to show the operation-specific fallback rather than raw exception text.
prdRefs: Requirements > R3 — Returned action messages outrank fallbacks

description: Malformed assignee identifiers in a stored board or tenant view are removed before ticket-list validation, including during SSR without a known-user list.

description: Valid stored assignee UUIDs remain active and duplicate UUIDs are normalized without changing unassigned-filter semantics.
